administrator_acceptance.decision: Follow the supplied V2 project plan, place it in the V2 development control state, and make it happen.

governing_principle: Context loss is not authority to reconstruct accepted work.

work_packages.title: V2 Architecture and Compatibility Contract
work_packages.objective: Define the exact legal relationship between v1 and v2 before implementation begins.
acceptance_boundaries: No implementation ambiguity remains for V2-02 through V2-05.
No silent v1 state conversion is required.
No accepted v1 disposition is rewritten.
All proposed new state has an explicit owner and lifecycle role.
Exact version/schema compatibility rules are reviewable.

work_packages.title: User Onboarding and Provider-Independent Adoption
work_packages.objective: Make Floppy usable by a person who has never seen the system before and make that entry path independent of any single AI provider.
acceptance_boundaries: All maintained provider guides use the same canonical Floppy semantics.
Provider-specific access instructions do not create provider-specific authority rules.
Class A/B/C workflows are documented.
Existing-project preservation is explicit.
Onboarding never silently authorizes implementation.

work_packages.title: Accepted-State Continuity Protection
work_packages.objective: Prevent context loss, model replacement, or re-onboarding from silently destroying or reconstructing accepted state.
acceptance_boundaries: A fresh model can read protected accepted state.
Protected accepted state cannot be replaced without the lawful revision pathway.

work_packages.title: Continuity Overseer and Orchestrator Succession
work_packages.objective: Add project-level continuity across project-orchestrator lifetimes.
acceptance_boundaries: Bounded orchestrator handoff succeeds without project restart.
Accepted work is not recreated.
Authority does not change merely because the orchestrator changes.

work_packages.title: Official Project Plan, Integration, Compatibility Validation, and V2 Release
work_packages.objective: Complete the design-to-execution handoff capability, integrate all v2 additions, prove compatibility, and publish v2.0.0.
acceptance_boundaries: New-user end-to-end proof passes.
Existing-project proof passes.
Existing-v1-project compatibility/adoption proof passes.
Orchestrator-continuity proof passes.
Provider-independence proof passes.
v2.0.0 is released only from exact accepted final main.
